rows.why: Passage states exactly this definition for purposes of this Regulation; the claim's value matches, and no exception or condition is dropped.
Passage states manufacturers must ensure accompaniment by instructions and Annex III information; no exception attached to that duty, and the digital-format sentence is permissive, not restrictive.
Passage states manufacturer must mark how to access digital instructions, with the fallback to packaging/document, and the claim keeps the digital-format condition.

Passage states the online accessibility period (expected lifetime and at least 10 years after placing on market); claim's condition carries the timing; paper-format proviso is a separate obligation, n
Passage requires manufacturers to immediately inform competent national authorities where risk is presented; the claim keeps the risk condition in full.
Passage is point 5 of Annex I, Part A, listing exactly this category; the claim's value matches and the passage attaches no further conditions.
The passage defines 'danger zone' with the same wording as the claim's value, and no exception or condition is attached beyond what the value contains.
Passage states manufacturer's duties (a)-(e) verbatim; the only framing, 'by the iterative process of risk assessment and risk reduction', is manner, not a restriction of scope.
Passage lists (e) as a step; the claim's condition (iterative risk assessment process) is shown only in the list lead-in, which is not in the passage, and no further restriction appears.
Passage states 45 days from complete request, after which employer may ask another body; claim's time limit and condition match, no extra restriction omitted.
Passage says authorities require operator to take corrective action when non-compliance found; claim includes the Where-condition, with no further restriction attached to the action.
Passage lists this machinery at Annex I Part A point 6; claim value copies it and keeps the 'in respect only of those systems' restriction.
The passage defines 'interchangeable equipment' exactly as claimed, and the claim's value and condition both include the proviso that the device is not a tool.
Claim reproduces the passage's obligation including the 'or, alternatively' option; the following sentence concerns a separate duty (digital accessibility), not a condition on this one.
Passage states the print/download/save format obligation; claim's condition (digital instructions) matches context, and no further exception appears in passage.

Passage says digital declarations accessible for expected lifetime and at least 10 years after placing on market/putting into service; claim covers the 10-year minimum and trigger, omitting nothing re
Passage says importer shall inform manufacturer and market surveillance authorities where machinery presents a risk; the claim's condition reproduces the risk qualifiers in full.
Passage lists these circular saws at Annex I Part B point 1; the claim's condition restates the wood/meat scope fully, so nothing is dropped.
Passage defines 'operator' with exactly this wording; no exceptions or conditions attached, and neighboring sentences are separate definitions.
Passage states the obligation for the manufacturer or authorised representative, and the claim's condition carries the Article 12 procedures scope.
Passage states the limits-of-safety-functions obligation, and the claim keeps the 'where such modifications could lead to hazardous situations' condition in its value.
Passage states the request must be made at least 45 days before the legal deadline; claim has no condition and passage attaches none to it.

Passage requires the economic operator to take all appropriate measures, and the claim's condition reproduces the full triggering clause; the 'or' alternatives (withdraw, recall) are separate obligati
Passage lists thicknessers for one-side dressing with built-in feed and manual loading/unloading, 'for woodworking'; claim's condition omits 'for woodworking' though value includes it.
The claim's value reproduces the definition of 'safety component' and its condition repeats the 'not necessary... or normal components may be substituted' proviso, so nothing is dropped.
Passage states distributors must verify items (a)-(d) before making machinery available; the claim copies the list and keeps the 'before making available' condition.
Claim reproduces the obligation, including the 'where not possible' alternatives, and the condition 'when instructions are in digital format' from the lead-in.
Passage states digital declarations accessible for expected lifetime and at least 10 years after placing on market or putting into service; the claim keeps that condition.

Passage states importers shall immediately inform competent national authorities where there is a risk; claim's condition reproduces the risk condition, though it omits the 'Member States in which mad
Passage lists these band-saws at Annex I Part B point 4; the claim's condition keeps manual loading/unloading and wood or meat, though 'similar material' and 'types' are omitted.

no_anchor.pattern: 48 open points with an empty quote; not recoverable

missing_condition.pattern: condition word in the quote, empty condition: 'if' 44, 'se' 6, except/unless/purché 1 each; one 'SE' is a company form, not Italian. recover_missing_condition rebuilds 46 (in the proposal under recovered_not_applied)

value_not_in_quote.pattern: line-break hyphens of the PDF ('installa- tore'), straight against curly apostrophe, paraphrased values; no rule written

not_in_schema.pattern: relation name invented by the model

reading_of_the_passed_facts_changed_or_f.fix_definition_whole: 13: the rule is right in all (the stored definition stopped early; the second reader accepts a shortened excerpt)
reading_of_the_passed_facts_changed_or_f.fix_period_floor_and_start: 7: the rule is right in all (the starting point was missing: 'from the date of issue of the certificate', 'after such upload')
reading_of_the_passed_facts_changed_or_f.fix_listed_item_whole: 4: harmless (the entry replaces its number); the second reader is right that nothing was wrong
reading_of_the_passed_facts_changed_or_f.fix_list_item: 3: the rule adds the opening sentence the reader had not asked for; correct text, no error repaired
reading_of_the_passed_facts_changed_or_f.fix_obligation_whole: 2: the rule is right (values 'are accompanied by' and 'shall verify that' were fragments)
reading_of_the_passed_facts_changed_or_f.check_accompany_not_stated: 6: items of a list of what the instructions contain; the rule's reading is defensible, the reader's too: flag only
reading_of_the_passed_facts_changed_or_f.dropped: fix_obligation_whole in its wide form (every cut duty lengthened): 40 failures against 72 passed facts changed; kept as fix_obligation_whole_wide, outside FIXES

criterion_for_close: a fact is closed only when a rebuilt fact that passed the gate replaces it; a check alone closes only a value that is a number or punctuation (none in this store); every other check result is flag_only
addressed_is_measured_by: code (asked_for): the rebuilt fact holds a word that the second reader's reason names and the old fact lacked: 69 of the 74 failures a rule fires on. Read by hand, the other 5 (st-0040, st-0152, st-0190, st-0247, st-1576) also change in the direction asked. Changed in the direction asked is not the same as passing: in the spot-check 13 of 15 formerly failed facts passed the second reader, 2 did not (st-0395, st-0396: the value is whole but the old condition is still the short one).
